payload.title: TI P4-06: create the new CMS app from the template, GitHub App connect, first build, release-gate checks
payload.description:
## Goal
Google sign-in works on the new CMS, an admin exists, editors are added. Same OAuth client as the other sites, new Cognito URIs added.

## Context (FACT)
- Google is the standard sign-in (docs/google-oauth-setup.md): Google Cloud Console takes the Cognito hosted-UI origin (https://papyrus-threat-intelligence.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com) as an Authorized JavaScript origin and https://papyrus-threat-intelligence.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/idpresponse as an Authorized redirect URI; the post-login landing URLs are NOT in Google but in cms.environment.PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS (feeds the Cognito app-client callback and logout URLs).
- Epic comment 4e3a16: Ryan removed the older Papyrus sites' URIs from Google client 94722830066-7pf0ui44... (project 94722830066) to stay under the 10 unverified-domain limit; Google sign-in on the OLD TI site is expected to be broken already (its Cognito domain b1f1d3a11a4545ba5318 is not listed any more).
- Old pool us-east-1_lAtce7ZTu: 2 users (CONFIRMED + EXTERNAL_PROVIDER), groups admin 1, editor 2, curator 0. Users are not migrated: they sign in again with Google on the new pool and an admin assigns groups.
- Amplify backend secrets live under /amplify/<appId>/<branch-branch-hash>/ where hash = first 10 hex chars of sha512(appId + branch) (for branch main); the template does not set them.

## Exact steps
1. Ryan (Google Cloud Console): add the two Cognito URIs above to the existing client; confirm the client still has room under the unverified-domain limit.
2. Ryan (Amplify console, new app, Hosting, Secrets): set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET for branch main (same values as the other sites; never pasted into chat or repo). OPENAI_API_KEY is not set (console responder and knowledge query stay off).
3. Re-run the main branch build so Cognito gets the Google provider; verify with aws cognito-idp describe-identity-provider (provider type Google exists) and describe-user-pool-client (callback and logout URLs list the new default origin, localhost:3001).
4. Ryan signs in at https://main.<newAppId>.amplifyapp.com/newsroom with Google; add him to group admin (aws cognito-idp admin-add-user-to-group on his explicit yes); add the editors.
5. Add the final public host https://threat-intelligence.anth.us/ to PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS in site.json when P4-11 runs (not now).

## Acceptance checks
- Hosted UI shows Continue with Google; sign-in lands on /newsroom with the admin role; an editor can open Articles; a non-member gets the access-denied state.
- Names only recorded for secrets (SSM parameter listing shows both parameter names, SecureString).

## Rollback
Remove the two URIs from the Google client; delete the secrets.

## Risks
Secret path hash mistakes (set via the console to avoid it). Unverified-domain limit.

## Needs Ryan
Yes: Google Cloud Console edit, console secrets, first sign-in, group assignments.

## Common rules (Phase 4 Threat Intelligence)
- Plan and facts: the assessment comment on the Phase 4 ticket (PPY-332889). Pattern: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md and docs/standard-site.md 3.2 on origin/develop.
- Ryan: Threat Intelligence is PRE-PRODUCTION; goal is to dogfood the new backend CMS UX before converting anth.us (production). Treat as a hard cutover with brief downtime accepted unless Ryan says otherwise (open question Q1). The OLD app d3on1y5vlrxmam and its backend stay untouched and serving until the retire ticket.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan or on his explicit yes. Read-only AWS calls are fine.
- NEVER use /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us as a build dir. TI repo work: fresh clone under /Users/home/Projects/ (delete afterwards), feature branch + PR, never push to its main. Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus (the board checkout) only run kbs; never git add or commit there.
- Gherkin first for any Papyrus behavior change (AGENTS.md). Long clear names, no line-level comments.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.
